definition: maxWse = max cell water-surface elevation zs over frames where the native cell is wet (native volume/area >= dryThresholdM and finite zs); maxOver = maxWse - roadZ. listed = every station that is not plain dry: over, below, unknown, no-cell, indexed into the static station file whose sha256 is stationsSha256. A station absent from listed with a road height is dry (known dry in every frame); no-road-height comes from the static file. unknown = not over in any valid frame, and at least one frame had no valid reading (never treated as dry or below). over can also carry unknownFrames >= 1 (some frames missing); below always has unknownFrames 0. maxWseCm = ceil(maxWse*100) clamped to the state: over max(.., roadZCm+1), below min(.., roadZCm); maxOverCm = maxWseCm - roadZCm. firstOverMin = minutes after forecastStart. Bare-earth lidar road height, not a surveyed deck; flags: deckLidar=1, deckApproach=2, noTerrain=4, structureUntagged=8.

source.elevation: NAVD88 metres, lidar bare-earth road estimate (not a surveyed deck)

selection.rule: covered by the case domain, more than 15 m from every rated route line

provenance.mapping: Exact native polygon containment in compact frame face order; shared-boundary ambiguity and outside stations are no-cell

limits: Model forecast, not observed water. Road heights are lidar-derived bare-earth estimates, not pavement or bridge-deck surveys. No bridge or culvert openings. Missing readings never establish a dry road.
